units: <cite ref="Megillah 16a:19">Meg. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>ובא מלאך וס׳ ידה וכ׳</he> and an angel came and turned her hand towards Haman.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:6">B. Kam. VIII, 6</cite> <he>סְטָרוֹ</he> if he slapped his neighbor, contrad. to <he>תקע</he> to strike with the fist, a. to <he>לאחר יד</he> with the back of the hand.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>סְטָרוֹ</he>, <he>סְטָרָן</he>; Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3, v. <cite ref="M01899"><he>מסְטוֹר</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01906"><he>מִסְטָר</he></cite>; a. fr.

Kidd. I, 61ᵇ top; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:6">Esth. R. to I, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:5">Lev.
